# Jitter RNG health test vector: repetition count test with memory (RCT-mem).
#
# A first window of deltas that are never stuck, the priming delta
# jent_random_data() takes between blocks - which the health tests do not
# judge - then a second window in which every delta the test observes - every
# third, from the window start on - is stuck: it repeats the last delta judged
# before it, for the first one the last delta of the first window. That reaches the cutoff of 321 at osr 3 in
# the second window only, which a replay judging just the first one reported
# as clean. The stuck deltas are isolated, so the RCT stays quiet, and the
# deltas vary otherwise, so the APT and the lag predictor do too.
#
# 963 + 1 + 961 deltas: a window of 963 at osr 3, the priming, and the second
# window up to its 321st observed delta.
#
# One decimal time stamp per line. Replay with:
#   tests/health/health --replay <this file>
